notes.title: Participation in the festival!
notes.content:
[b]Attention, Defenders of Asgard![/b]

The NordVader Inc. team proudly announces the release of the first demo of our action shooter, [b]Asgard's Edda: Mechanical Threat[/b]! Like ancient blacksmiths, we honed our training grounds, brewed code, and now – the demo is ready for you to dive into an epic world where Norse mythology meets the technology of the future. And all this at the "[b]Next Fest[/b]" festival!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3393260/

In the demo, you will find yourself on the Asgardian base – a unique location still in development but already imbued with the spirit of the battles to come. Here you will face the first type of enemy – simple yet no less cunning minions of the Architect. Our arsenal is still limited: for now, you’re armed only with what’s available at the start, while the full in-game shop with weapons, ammunition, and gear is still backstage, preparing for its moment in the spotlight. But doesn’t a little adversity build character? We believe it is these challenges that help true warriors taste the thrill of battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157376/d748384d7298022986da2b43435ba609223af2ff.png[/img]

What’s next? Great achievements are already on the horizon! In the first iteration of the game, you can expect the addition of at least three new enemy types, including a formidable boss who will test your courage to the very last drop of blood. In addition, we are preparing a co-op mode – so you can fight side by side with your friends – and we’re introducing a shop for purchases between waves, ensuring you can recover your strength even in the most intense moments. You will find all the details of our plans in our detailed Roadmap, embedded directly in the demo. Check it out to see how we plan to make this world even more captivating!

The demo version of Asgard's Edda: Mechanical Threat is not just another prelude to the full release. It is our call to arms, an invitation to all who are ready to become defenders of Asgard, experience the game firsthand, and share their thoughts and suggestions. Your feedback, comments, and even criticism will help us refine every detail so that the final version becomes truly epic! So we ask you: download the demo, add it to your wishlist, and leave your reviews. Your engagement is the key to turning our project into a true legend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157376/e8b710457567e4df2bb85a6be45ec0eae39eb32a.gif[/img]

Remember, the "[b]Next Fest[/b]" is your chance to immerse yourself in the atmosphere of future battles. Join us, explore the Asgardian base, fight the first enemies, and be among the first to see what our world will look like when it reaches its full power. Follow all our announcements and news on our channels: Discord, YouTube, Telegram – where we’ll share the freshest details, insider info, and more.

[url=https://discord.gg/MYcNZTg3k4 style=button]Discord[/url] [url=https://t.me/nordvader style=button]Telegram[/url] [url=https://www.patreon.com/nordvader style=button]Patreon[/url] 
 
So, warriors, don’t hesitate! Asgard calls its defenders, and we are already preparing new challenges, battles, and legendary fights for you. Download the demo, leave your feedback, and together we will make Asgard's Edda: Mechanical Threat a game that will be sung about in sagas!
